summary: A network platform is a set of devices sharing an OS managed by one collection, such as arista.eos, cisco.ios/iosxr/nxos, junipernetworks.junos and vyos.vyos.
questions: Which collection do I need for Cisco IOS devices?

answer_card.title: Network platform collections
answer_card.answer_md:
- Arista: `arista.eos`
- Cisco: `cisco.ios`, `cisco.iosxr`, `cisco.nxos`
- Juniper: `junipernetworks.junos`
- VyOS: `vyos.vyos`

Modules within a platform share requirements; check platform docs for specifics.
